[[File:Variants.png|thumb|108px|The [[Compendium]] icon.|link=Compendium]]
Variants are alternate versions of a parasite or assimilated mob that may have different stats, apply effects, or simply just a different texture.

The following variant types exist:

=='''<span style="color:#AA0000;">Berserker Variants</span>'''==
Berserker variants apply the [[Bleeding]] effect on hit.

=='''Miscellaneous Variants'''==
Smaller variant types with miscellaneous differences from their normal form.

==='''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Empty Carriers</span>'''===
Empty Carriers contain no mobs, have faster movement speed, and spreads higher potencies of effects upon bursting.  All [[:Category:Inborn_Parasites|Inborn]] carriers have an Empty Variant.

<div style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.1);padding:1em;border-left:5px solid #475715">
<gallery position="center" captionalign="center" navigation="true" hideaddbutton="true">
EmptyHeavyCarrier.png|link=Heavy_Carrier|[[Heavy Carrier]]
Flying Carrier.png|link=Flying_Carrier|[[Flying Carrier]]
Light Carrier.png|link=Light_Carrier|[[Light Carrier]]
</gallery>
</div>

==='''<span style="color:#AA00AA;">Armored Variants</span>'''===
Only two [[Preeminent_Parasites|Preeminent Parasites]] have an Armored variant:
*The [[Colony Carrier|Colony Carrier's]] Armored variant has 5 ([[File:Armor.png]][[File:Armor.png]][[File:Halfarmor.png]]) more armor points but a slower moving speed.
*The [[Haunter|Haunter's]] Armored variant inflicts 1.5x melee damage but has half the HP.

<div style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.1);padding:1em;border-left:5px solid #475715">
<gallery position="center" captionalign="center" navigation="true" hideaddbutton="true">
ArmoredColonyCarrier.png|link=Colony_Carrier|[[Colony Carrier]]
ArmoredHaunter.png|link=Haunter|[[Haunter]]
</gallery>
</div>

==='''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Other Variants</span>'''===
These variants fit into no particular group whatsoever.  Some of these variants, such as that of the Assimilated Human and Villager, existed before any other Variants were added.
*The [[Adapted Longarms|Adapted Longarm's]] '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Tyrant</span>''' variant inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.
*The [[Primitive Reeker|Primitive Reeker's]] '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Pale</span>''' variant inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.
*The [[Monarch|Monarch's]] '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Deviantive</span>''' variant inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.
*The [[Assimilated Big Spider|Assimilated Big Spider's]] '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Second</span>''' variant presents Half HP compared to a normal Assimilated Big Spider.
*The [[Assimilated Enderman|Assimilated Enderman's]] '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Crawling</span>''' variant is in crawling position, having a smaller hitbox able to fit in 1x1.5x1 spaces.
*The '''<span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Nocturn</span>''' variant of the [[Assimilated Human]] and [[Assimilated Villager]], as well as their Walking Heads, have identical stats to their normal variants.
*A number of mobs have unique texture variants that present no other changes to them, such as the elusive Golden [[Rupter]].
